subject: Superintendent Contract Negotiations
overview: The School Committee convened for a special meeting to enter executive session regarding contract negotiations with the Superintendent of Schools. The committee adjourned directly from the executive session without returning to open session.

items.title: Call to Order and Pledge of Allegiance
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn called the special meeting to order and led the Pledge of Allegiance.

items.title: Executive Session: Superintendent Contract Negotiations
items.summary: Approved entry into executive session to conduct strategy and contract negotiations with the Superintendent of Schools, with the committee electing to adjourn directly from that session.
